Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 8)
Topic: The Aghor Panth — Rising Above the Devtas, and Why We Need Agni Tattva
Source: Bhaiya's satsang session (video transcript, ~1hr 29min), Mool Tattva series (a special detour within the Surya Vigyan chapters). Purpose: Chatbot knowledge — English version.
1. SESSION CONTEXT

Two Surya Vigyan chapters had been taught; before chapter three, this session records what happened two days earlier: Aghor-panth sants of the Nath community came (astrally) to Ashaeiynn — sat in lines, and taught at length. They analyzed Mahavatari Baba, explained many panths, and revealed vidyas "we had never even heard of." Bhaiya records it now "so it stays on record." Bhaiya's honest confession: he never used to respect the Aghor panth ("lying in ﬁlth — what is there to respect?"). Gurudev began correcting that view — and then the Aghori sants themselves came to complete the correction.

"Sab kuchh rachit hota hai" — everything is or chestrated: even the audience sitting that day wasn't their own doing; the session itself was arranged from above. Knowledge policy restated: Ashaeiynn puts none of this on YouTube — "Gurudev's gyaan is priceless"; it is taught only to the chosen; even entry, seating, who interrupts, and who is pulled away mid-session is run entirely by Gurudev. Nothing here is book-knowledge: "we have never lifted a book to gain knowledge — this is sukshma gyaan, astral knowledge, available only through divya drishti." A member's report endorsed: a sant had told him "the Earth is made of ONE tattva" — the same thing a sant had once told Bhaiya.
2. THE GOVERNING PRINCIPLE — DEVTAS RUN EVERYTHING

Every religion acknowledges divine governance under diﬀerent names : peerpaigambar/Allah in Islam, devi-devtas in Hinduism, angels, Isa Masih (Jesus), Guru Nanak Dev Ji's tattvas, Jerusalem's entities — some divine entity governs every person. What falls under the devtas: what you eat, what digests in your body, what you wear, where you live, how your children come, what happens to your coming generations — roti, kapda, makaan — everything. And one more critical thing: your body's TAAP (heat/agni). This is the fact the Aghor panth understood better than anyone — and decided to escape.
3. CASE STUDY — CHUNNI WALE BABA (the two-triangle secret of the body)
The famous Gujarat saint (Chunni/Chundadi wale Baba — diﬀer ent names in diﬀer ent places), studied Ashaeiynn-style:

1. A boy lived with his mother, who carried a female negative entity (pretni). The mother died — note the standing law : "no shakti can decide the day of a human's living or dying" (the pretni did not "eat" her, whatever people say). 2. The entity shifted from mother to child. A sant saw it and said: only Adi Shakti can save you now. 3. The boy took up Mata's sadhna — became so absorbed in her charitra that he began seeing himself in the Mata's/feminine form. His mantra-shakti grew so great that the pretni, defeated by the jaap, climbed the dimensions oﬀ his body and was granted a lok — r eleased. 4. Mata gave sakshaat darshan: "ask, son." Having starved door-to-door all childhood, he asked only: "Free me from hunger and thirst, so I may do your bhakti forever." Mata granted
the siddhi — he never felt hunger or thirst again. Scientists came, studied, went mad, and left. His samadhi stands in Gujarat today.
What divya drishti shows (the mechanism of the siddhi)

Seen with divya drishti, his body showed two triangles, inverted against each other, meeting at their tips — one holding AGNI tattva, the other JAL tattva. At the meeting point, a drop falls from the jal-triangle onto the agni below — and energy is produced: the same energy the body normally makes from food and water (an apple becomes energy; water becomes energy). His body made it directly. Lesson: the human body runs on two main tattvas — AGNI and JAL — and their union generates the body's shakti. The Aghor panth grasped this completely.
4. DIMENSION CLIMBING — WHY SADHAKS GET ATTACKED

As a sadhak does jaap/sadhna, they climb dimensions. Law: every dimension you climb increases the attacks on you — each dimension must be fought thr ough and crossed. Beyond bhoot-pret (a small matter), at the next level the attackers are — hear it plainly — the siddhis seated in nearby temples: Hanuman Ji Maharaj's siddhis, Shani Maharaj's, Bholenath's, the peer-paigambar of nearby shrines — the very beings we bow to . "The one seated in the mandir will be the ﬁrst to wrap you — because you ar e steadily rising to his level." Why (and why it is NOT Bhagwan's jealousy): the classroom analogy — 100 childr en all chanting and climbing; one gets stuck at a dimension; he cannot go up, so he pulls the others down. "Bhagwan has nothing to do with it — He is not making them attack. The 100 classmates fear the monitor's badge will be taken by you." Even divine servants compete for sthaan (position) — lik e the military: the ﬁnest, ﬁttest, highest-IQ men, who would die for others and never torment the weak, still compete ﬁer cely among equals for rank. Equals battle equals; the winner rises. Practical example: a sister doing long jaap with mounting body pains asked "who is doing kriya on me?" — Bhaiya: "No kriya. Y ou are climbing steadily; these are attacks." If Anshu's dimension rises to match the doots of the Panchmukhi Balaji mandir 5 km away, those shaktis WILL attack — not for the person, but for the tarang of the dimension being climbed: "for that tarang, beings will kill." Sobering observation: many elderly people and sants who chant day and night live in terrible body pain and die worn out — people say "they took God's name so much, why such suﬀering?" — sometimes it is not negativity but the PRAKOP OF SIDDHIS: the person climbed high on naam alone, with no agni tattva, and was cut down. "You took only the naam's support, not the agni's. Naam needs agni with it."
The ceiling law

You can never rise above the devta whose support you take. Whatever you receive — food, clothing, progress, dimensions — comes fr om the devtas, so their level is your ceiling. Bhaiya's own proud position: "I can NEVER go above my Gurudev Shri Hanuman Ji Maharaj — not in crores of births, no matter how many dimensions I touch — and I accept this with joy. We are his daas."
5. THE AGHOR PANTH — THE ESCAPE ROUTE ABOVE THE DEVTAS
The Aghoris refuse the ceiling: "stuck at one dimension? Iski aisi-taisi." They never take the devtas' shakti — they kick it aside — because whoever tak es, stays below.
Aghor means "not ghor" — that which is NOT diﬃcult. The path is (in their frame) simple.
The 10-year foundation (no mantra at all)

In the Aghor panth, no guru-mantra is given for 10 (to 10.5, even 15) years. (Contrast: "you people take guru-mantras every other day — some sitting her e carry ﬁve.") Those 10 years build ONE thing: the body's agni tattva — raised to a level wher e nothing can enter its circle. Ten years of building nothing but their own security. Method — hath yoga in extreme conditions: extreme heat in summer, extreme cold in winter; tapobal built relentlessly. The logic taught on day one: "we are going to kick the devtas — so the devtas will not even let us oﬀer ahutis; we won't be able to do havan; therefore everything must be generated within ourselves." Step 1 — Pinddaan of oneself: the entrant's own funeral rites are performed. "No home, no family, no lineage." A complete pinddaan ends the pitru entanglement permanently — no pitru can ever come. (That energy freed. Though — mistak es happen; some Aghoris still show pitrs behind them where the ritual didn't fully fructify.) Step 2 — Locking brahmacharya energy: a keel (nail/spike) is pierced through the skin beneath the reproductive organ, keeping constant pain there — so the ener gy never ﬂows out, never even gets touched or thought about. The seed-ener gy stays locked and utilized. Step 3 — extreme temperature conditioning until the agni is beyond measure. Result: "One mantra-jaap of an Aghori creates agni equal to the agni of 10,000 havans." For ten years they don't chant at all — they meditate, sleep, r oam free ("fail gaye, enjoy") — no concer n for appearance.
The one mantra — Mahamrityunjaya (and why)

After 10 years, they receive one single mantra — the FULL Mahamrityunjaya mantra (not the beej, not Om Namah Shivay — those ar e "sweet pills" handed to visitors: "le jaa, tu kya yaad rakhega"). Prescription: only 3 malas a day. The mantra's meaning is the whole strategy: "Om tryambakam yajamahe… — O Lord, as the ripened fruit releases its branch, may no shakti be able to kill me before the breaths written for me are fully lived." After 10 years of tapasya, ALL they ask is: let nothing kill me before my time. ("Look at their science — our whole system shak es.") Every mantra has a devta/rachyita (a creator — who composed the P anchakshar? the Ram-Taraka?). Within 2–3 months of those 3 daily malas, the mantra's devta manifests to grant boons: "maango, vats."
The one day the whole tapasya was for

When the devta appears oﬀering boons, the Aghori says: "Jaa, apna kaam kar. Nikal yahan se." (Go, do your work. Out.) — the door is shown, sometimes with insults. The entire 10–12-year tapasya was for this single da y — the day they r efuse the devta's boon, refusing to come under any devta. The devta, insulted in his own domain, retaliates: cuts oﬀ roti-kapda-makaan (all under devta jurisdiction) — what will he eat, wear, wher e will he live, what of his future? Then sends the big shaktis of the region ("the ones who attend the big summits — not bhoot-pr et; they don't even go"). But the 10 years of agni holds: nothing can enter that ﬁre. And if something does force in — their Guru's guru-mantra "eats its life." The devtas attack, tire, and ﬁnally concede: "nipat liya — jao" (enough — go). Only when the devtas concede does the Aghori rise ABOVE the devtas.
Above the devtas

Past that line, "the real chamatkar begins" — r eading minds is nothing compared to it. The devtas' rules no longer apply to them. They gain the authority to manifest anyone, to reduce anyone to ash, to combine every tattva the devtas hold. They sit in the mountains so no one sees them; apsaras come to them directly; Mahavatari Baba meets them sakshaat (as he did Lahiri Mahashay and the great saints — and still does, in e xactly this form). "Don't take the Aghor sants lightly — their parties ar e legendary AND their tapasya is legendary. Both beyond our imagination." Longevity: since nothing may kill them before their written breaths end, they live the longest and celebrate the hardest.
The money clause

No Aghori — and no one blessed by an Aghori — will have money. Money ﬂows under devta jurisdiction, and they have fought the devtas; taking money would need a contract signed with the devtas. "Everything except money comes to them." (Anecdote: a great political leader who took an Aghori's blessing was warned — "k eep money with yourself and you are ﬁnished.") P ower is real, but power ≠ money, maya, or luxury.
6. NEVER CATEGORIZE — THE RANKING WARNING

Asked "which category of devtas — the T rinity?": "Do not judge or rank the categories at all." Brahma–Vishnu–Mahesh also belong to the dev-yoni; never sort devtas into "small" and "big" — that habit is ours, not r eality's. The glass-of-water teaching: insult the little water in a glass ("what power do you have? I only respect the ocean") — but that water is the devta's tattva, and "if it phones the ocean/union, you are ﬁnished." Same for bhoot-prets — belittle no one: "chhota bachcha jaan ke na koi aankh dikhana re." Bhagwan has given everyone their sthaan; no one is small or big — small and big are our inventions. Regional-dominance analogy: every tattva rules somewhere — Jats dominate in Haryana, Yadavs/Thakurs in UP, Pandits elsewhere; go to each place and see whose writ runs. The astral world is the same — "far bigger than you think, and far mor e versatile."
The Kedarnath reel (what looks divine may be something else)

A viral reel showed two sadhus chanting at Kedarnath at 3 a.m. with a towering ﬁgur e behind them. First glance: Bholenath — pranam. Second look: their Guru? — pranam. F inally clear: it was their own KUNDALINI SHAKTI standing outside their bodies. Meanwhile ordinary pilgrims (a member's parents) visited Kedarnath and brought negativity home — the same gr ound, utterly diﬀer ent outcomes, because of what each carried. Lesson: don't do "wah-wah" at spectacles — lear n what you are actually seeing; that discernment is drishti.
7. WHAT WE (GRIHASTHAS) MUST LEARN FROM THE AGHORIS
We cannot walk their path — and should not:

1. We cannot leave our lineage — so pitrs will k eep troubling us; we also carry purva-janma and generational shraps/dosh that must be worked through. 2. We want everything — money, family, childr en, bhakti, dimensions, comfort — and ALL of it ﬂows fr om the devtas. We are built into society and cannot exit it.

3. Therefore: we can only advance while remaining in the devtas' sanidhya and protection. Fight them and lose everything; honor them and rise with support. 4. But mantra-jaap and tapasya alone will NOT carry you — the naam needs A GNI. Two sources exist: tap (the Aghori road — 10 years of hath yoga, closed to us) or HAVAN in guru-sanidhya, where the jagrit mantra makes the devtas themselves accept the ahutis — the agni born of THAT havan is what protects you. (This completes Session 7's havan teaching.) 5. The sukshma sharir calling you across births carries an agni you cannot build in this one lifetime — that is why help from there (guru-shakti) is required (as taught in the previous video). 6. The Hanuman Ji / Bhagwan Ram model is ours: inﬁnitely powerful, yet honoring relationship after relationship. "Live in the world honoring relationships, and the world's sukh is yours; break them all, and you must renounce the sukh that lives here." The devtas themselves honor this — it is the devta way, and the grihastha way . 7. Timeline reality: our life is ~70 years; we only understand by 35 what jaap even is; "in barely 5 years we claim devtas are in our ﬁst — that is wr ong." So take guru-sanidhya and learn from those already accomplished.
8. QUICK RULES SUMMARY

1. Some divine entity governs every person, in every religion — food, clothing, home, childr en, generations, and the body's taap all sit under devta jurisdiction. 2. The body runs on two main tattvas — agni and jal; their union at the twin-triangle point generates the body's energy (Chunni wale Baba's siddhi). 3. No shakti can decide the day of a human's death. 4. Climbing dimensions attracts attacks — fr om equals, including temple-seated siddhis defending their sthaan. It is competition, never Bhagwan's jealousy. 5. Naam without agni ends badly — chr onic pain in lifelong chanters can be siddhi-prakop, not negativity. Pair the naam with agni (havan). 6. You can never rise above the devta whose support you take. The Aghoris escape the ceiling by taking nothing — 10 years of agni-building (pinddaan of self, lock ed brahmacharya, hath yoga), then Mahamrityunjaya (3 malas), then refusing the mantra-devta's boon and outlasting the devtas' siege. 7. One Aghori jaap = the agni of 10,000 havans. Above the devtas, devta-rules don't apply — but no money, ever (money needs a devta-contract). 8. Never rank devtas (or any being) as big/small — the glass can phone the ocean; everyone holds a Bhagwan-given sthaan. 9. What looks like Bholenath behind a sadhu may be his own kundalini standing outside — lear n to see before you celebrate.

10. Grihastha path: stay in devta-sanidhya, honor relationships (the Hanuman Ji/Ram model), and get your agni from guru-sanidhya havan — not fr om a path built for renunciates. 11. Everything is rachit — even who sits in the session; and this gyaan is guar ded, never broadcast.
Bhaiya's Teachings — Q&A Pairs (Session 8, English)
The Aghor Panth — Rising Above the Devtas, and Why We Need Agni Tattva
User-style questions with answers grounded in Bhaiya's discourse. Greeting style: "Jai Siya Ram."

Q1. Who are the Aghoris really? Aren't they just people who live in ﬁlth? A: Jai Siya Ram! Bhaiya confessed he once thought exactly that — and Gurudev cor rected him, after which Aghor-panth sants of the Nath community themselves came to Ashaeiynn and taught. The truth: the Aghor panth solved a problem the rest of us never even see — the devta ceiling. "Aghor" means "not ghor" — not diﬃcult. Their tapasya is beyond our imagination, their knowledge is real, and Mahavatari Baba himself meets sants of this path directly. Never take them lightly.

Q2. What is the "devta ceiling"? A: Everything you receive — food, what digests in you, clothing, home, children, your coming generations, even your body's taap — ﬂows under devta jurisdiction (every religion names these governors diﬀer ently: devi-devtas, peer-paigambar, angels). The law: you can never rise above the devta whose support you take. Bhaiya embraces this joyfully — "I can never go above my Gurudev Hanuman Ji Maharaj, and I am his daas." The Aghoris refuse the ceiling — and pay its full price.

Q3. How does the Aghor path actually work? A: In stages, over ~10–12 years. First, NO mantra for 10 years — only building the body's agni tattva thr ough hath yoga in extreme conditions, until nothing can enter its circle. Their own pinddaan is performed (ending the pitru connection permanently), and brahmacharya energy is locked (a keel pierced beneath the reproductive organ keeps constant pain so the seed-energy never ﬂows out). A fter 10 years, one Aghori jaap equals the agni of 10,000 havans. Only then is a single mantra given — the full Mahamrityunjaya, 3 malas a day — and within 2–3 months its devta manifests to oﬀer boons. And then comes the day the whole tapasya was for: they refuse the boon — "jaa, apna k aam kar" — and outlast the devtas' r etaliation until the devtas concede. Only then do they rise above.

Q4. Why do the Aghoris chant Mahamrityunjaya of all mantras? A: Look at the science. Its meaning: "as the ripe fruit releases its branch, may no shakti kill me before my written breaths are complete." After ten years of tapasya, ALL they ask is that nothing cut them down before their time — because their plan is to insult and outlast the devtas, and they need to survive the
siege. That is also why they live the longest. (The Om Namah Shivay and beej mantras handed to visitors are "sweet pills" — the r eal prescription is the full mantra, 3 malas.)

Q5. Why don't Aghoris — or people they bless — ever have money? A: Because money ﬂows under devta jurisdiction, and they have fought the devtas. T o receive money they would have to sign a contract with the very devtas they defeated. So everything EXCEPT money comes to them. Remember Bhaiya's line: power is real, but power is not money, maya, or luxury.

Q6. I do intense jaap and my body aches constantly. Is someone doing kriya on me? A: Very possibly not. As you do sadhna you climb dimensions, and every dimension you climb increases the attacks — this is the cost of rising, not necessarily an enemy's kriya. A sister in the sangat had exactly this ("who is doing kriya on me?") and the answer was: no one — you ar e climbing, and equals at each level are contesting you. The remedy is not fear but AGNI: pair your naam with havan so the attacks cannot land.

Q7. Who attacks a climbing sadhak? Surely not divine beings? A: Hear it plainly, as Bhaiya taught: beyond bhoot-pret, the attackers at higher levels are the siddhis seated in nearby temples — the very beings we bow to . Not because Bhagwan is jealous — "Bhagwan k o kuchh nahi padi hai" — but because of sthaan-competition: the classr oom analogy (100 children climbing; the one stuck at a level pulls the risers down so the monitor's badge isn't taken). Even the ﬁnest military men — who would die for others — compete ﬁer cely at their own rank. Equals battle equals; the winner rises.

Q8. Elderly people who chant God's name day and night often suﬀer terrible pain. Why would God allow that? A: God isn't doing it. Sometimes it is not negativity at all but the prakop of siddhis: the person climbed high on naam ALONE, with no agni tattva, and was cut down by the competition at those levels. "You took only the naam's support, not the agni's." This is precisely why naam must be paired with havan-agni — and why Ashaeiynn insists on it (Session 7's teaching completed).

Q9. Was Chunni wale Baba's hunger-free siddhi real? How did it work? A: Real — his samadhi stands in Gujarat; scientists studied him and left baﬄed. The mechanism, seen thr ough divya drishti: two inverted triangles meeting at their tips — one car rying agni tattva, one jal tattva. A drop falls from the jal onto the agni at the meeting point, producing directly the energy the body normally makes from food and water. Mata granted him this after his sadhna freed him of the pretni that had come from his late mother — he ask ed for nothing but freedom from hunger and thirst so he could do bhakti forever. Core lesson: the body runs on two main tattvas, agni and jal.

Q10. Did the pretni kill his mother? A: No — and this is a standing law worth engraving: "no shakti can decide the day of a human's living or dying." People rush to say "the pretni ate her" — wrong. The mother's time was written. The entity merely shifted to the child after her death.

Q11. Are some devtas bigger than others? Which category attacked — the Trinity level? A: Bhaiya refused the question's premise: never categorize or rank devtas — Brahma, Vishnu, Mahesh also belong to the dev-yoni, and "small vs big" is our invention, not reality's. The glass-of-water teaching: mock the little water in a glass, and "if it phones the ocean, you are ﬁnished." The same applies even to bhoot-pr ets — "chhota bachcha jaan k e na koi aankh dikhana re." Everyone holds a sthaan given by Bhagwan. Every tattva rules somewhere (Jats in Haryana, Yadavs/Thakurs in UP…) — the astral world is bigger and mor e versatile than you think.

Q12. I saw a video of sadhus at Kedarnath with a giant ﬁgure behind them — was it Bholenath? A: Bhaiya studied that very reel. First glance said Bholenath — pranam. Second guess: their Guru. The truth after patient seeing: it was their own KUNDALINI SHAKTI standing outside their bodies. Meanwhile, ordinary pilgrims visited the same Kedarnath and brought negativity home. Lesson: the same ground gives diﬀer ent outcomes depending on what you carry — and don't "wah-wah" at spectacles; lear n to see what is actually there. That discernment is drishti.

Q13. Should I follow the Aghori path to escape the devtas' control? A: No — and Bhaiya is emphatic about why. We grihasthas cannot leave our lineage (so pitrs remain our work), we carry generational dosh, and we want everything the devtas give — money, family, childr en, comfort, bhakti. We are woven into society and cannot exit it. Fight the devtas and lose it all. Our path: advance WITHIN the devtas' sanidhya and protection, honoring relationships the way Hanuman Ji Maharaj and Bhagwan Ram do — inﬁnitely powerful, yet honoring bond af ter bond. "Live in the world honoring relationships, and the world's sukh is yours." And realistically: life is ~70 years, we understand jaap only by 35 — the 10- year hath-yoga road is closed to us. Take guru-sanidhya instead.

Q14. Then where do I get the agni the Aghoris get from tapasya? A: From HAVAN in gurusanidhya. Two sources of agni tattva exist: tap (the Aghori road) or the havan where the jagrit mantra makes the devtas themselves accept the ahutis — the agni bor n of that havan protects you exactly as the Aghori's tapobal protects him. This is why naam + havan is Ashaeiynn's constant prescription, and why the sukshma sharir calling you across births needs help you cannot generate in one lifetime.

Q15. Why doesn't Ashaeiynn put this knowledge on YouTube? A: Because Gurudev's gyaan is priceless and guarded. "We have never lifted a book — this is sukshma gyaan r eceived directly from Gurudev, taught only to those Prabhu has chosen." Even who sits in a session, for how long, and who gets pulled away mid-way is run by Gurudev — sab k uchh rachit hota hai. Views and subscribers are not the goal; drishti is. Whoever wants it must come through the process, with Gurudev's permission.
Bot Response Guidelines (Session 8 additions)

Treat the Aghor panth with explicit respect (Bhaiya's own corrected stance) — never mock renunciate traditions; equally, NEVER advise a user to attempt Aghori practices (pinddaan of self, body piercing, extreme hath yoga, defying devtas). Always redirect to the grihastha path: guru-sanidhya + havan + naam. If a user reports chronic pain alongside heavy jaap: introduce the dimension-climbing/siddhiprakop concept, recommend pairing naam with havan-agni, AND advise proper medical evaluation — never attribute pain solely to astral causes. Never validate ranking of deities ("which god is bigger") — use the glass-and- ocean teaching; extend the no-belittling rule even to bhoot-prets. On death questions: hold the law ﬁr mly — no shakti decides a human's death-day; gently counter "the spirit killed them" narratives. On spectacle videos/reels of sadhus and miracles: model the three-look discipline (it may be kundalini, not the deity) — teach discer nment, don't dismiss or hype. The "temple siddhis attack climbers" teaching is sensitive: frame it exactly as Bhaiya did — sthaan-competition among equals, explicitly NOT the deity's jealousy, and Bhagwan uninvolved — to avoid users concluding temples ar e hostile. Pair it with Session 5's dhamrespect rules. Money questions re: blessed persons/institutions: the devta-contract concept explains why true renunciates are moneyless — never use it to accuse speciﬁc persons. Spelling note: the institute's name is written "Ashaeiynn" — use this spelling consistently . Useful quotable lines: "Sab kuchh rachit hota hai", "No shakti can decide the day of a human's death", "Naam needs agni with it", "One Aghori jaap = 10,000 havans' agni", "The glass can phone the ocean", "Chhota bachcha jaan ke na koi aankh dikhana re", "Live in the world honoring relationships, and the world's sukh is yours."
